content_sections.text: The qualifying degree/diploma must be from a National Level institute of repute, or a recognized Indian University, under the full-time/regular scheme only. rows.post_qualification_experience: Min. 6 years in project planning, analysis, design, detailing and execution of structural works (RCC, structural steel, foundations); proficient in STAAD Pro, ETABS, SAFE, AutoCAD; BIM knowledge an advantage
Min. 6 years in design, installation, execution, testing, commissioning and maintenance of HVAC systems for commercial, residential, healthcare and infrastructure projects
Min. 6 years in planning, design, coordination, execution support and supervision of electrical systems for healthcare and large-scale infrastructure projects

Min. 6 years in planning, design, coordination and execution support of plumbing and public health engineering (PHE) systems for large-scale infrastructure, commercial, institutional and healthcare projects

rows.essential_education: B.E./B.Tech or Diploma (Biomedical Engineering/Electronics & Communication), Full Time
rows.post_qualification_experience: Min. 3 years (Degree holders) / 10 years (Diploma holders) in planning, design, coordination and implementation of biomedical engineering systems for healthcare infrastructure

Min. 3 years (Degree) / 10 years (Diploma) in quantity estimation, rate analysis, BOQ preparation, tender documentation, cost control, measurement, billing and contract administration for large-scale infrastructure projects
Min. 10 years in project planning and execution & contract management of civil and allied works for large, multi-storied buildings, preferably hospitals/healthcare projects

Min. 6 years executing and managing large-scale infrastructure and building projects (commercial, institutional, healthcare), with site execution, construction planning, coordination, quality control and resource management expertise
Min. 3 years (Degree) / 10 years (Diploma) in site supervision, construction planning, quality control, quantity estimation and coordination with contractors/consultants

content_sections.heading: HITES Recruitment 2026 Pay Scale & Compensation
content_sections.text: In addition to Basic Pay + Dearness Allowance (pre-revised), employees are entitled to Annual Increment, EPF, Gratuity, Medical reimbursement, leave encashment, etc., as per Company Rules, along with career progression opportunities.

content_sections.heading: HITES Recruitment 2026 Selection Process
content_sections.text: Eligible candidates are shortlisted based on initial scrutiny and called for Interview / Skill Assessment Test; individual communication is sent to shortlisted candidates. HITES reserves the right to conduct a preliminary interview, written test, Group Discussion (GD), or any combination of these, as part of the selection process, depending on the volume of response received for a position. Merely meeting the job requirements does not entitle a candidate to be called for interview; Management may raise the standard of specifications to restrict the number of candidates called, depending on response volume. Depending on suitability shown at interview, a candidate may be offered a lower position (for which they have also applied) than the one applied for. Appointment of selected candidates is subject to verification of credentials from the concerned authorities, as per Company rules, and subject to being found medically fit as per Company directives. Internal HITES candidates currently working in lower scales are also eligible for selection on merit, per the advertised criteria. No TA/DA is provided for attending the interview.

faq.question: Q1. How many posts has HITES advertised?
faq.answer: 21 posts across 9 positions in Infrastructure Development (Design and Execution) and Biomedical Engineering, on a Fixed Term Contract basis.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: 10 October 2026, till 6:00 PM; the application window opened on 19 September 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: It ranges from 40 to 47 years depending on the position, with age relaxation of 5 years for SC/ST, 3 years for OBC, and 10 years for PWD candidates.

faq.question: Q4. What is the pay scale?
faq.answer: Rs. 29,100–54,500 (Chief Manager), Rs. 24,900–50,500 (Senior Operations Manager), and Rs. 20,600–46,500 (Operations Manager), on the IDA pre-revised scale.

faq.question: Q5. How long is the contract?
faq.answer: Initially 3 years, renewable based on performance and organizational requirement.

faq.question: Q6. Is there a written test?
faq.answer: Not by default; selection is via shortlisting and interview/skill assessment, though HITES may add a written test or GD depending on the response received.

faq.question: Q7. Can I be posted anywhere in India?
faq.answer: Yes. Selected candidates must be willing to serve at any HITES location/office across India (and possibly overseas), and may be posted to other relevant disciplines as required.

faq.question: Q8. Where do I apply?
faq.answer: Online only, through hllhites.com; only online applications are accepted.
